title: CppCon 2016: Herb Sutter “Leak-Freedom in C++... By Default.”
summary: Herb Sutter's CppCon 2016 talk on lifetime safety in C++, aiming for code free of leaks and dangling pointers by default. It covers smart pointers, ownership, reference counting pitfalls and deferred reclamation resembling garbage collection.
why: HN cites it in memory management debates for its treatment of reference counting problems, destructor stack overflows and deferred pointers.
